8.7.1 Mandatory interfaces
Note: This section defines all interfaces, which are required to fulfill the core functionality of the module.
[SWS_KeyM_00076] Definition of mandatory interfaces required by module Key M Upstream requirements: SRS_CryptoStack_00118
⌈
API Function Header File Description Csm_KeyElementGet Csm.h Retrieves the key element bytes from a specific key element of the key identified by the keyId and stores the key element in the memory location pointed by the key pointer. Csm_KeyElementSet Csm.h Sets the given key element bytes to the key identified by keyId. Csm_KeySetValid Csm.h Sets the key state of the key identified by keyId to valid.
